reply_text:
I couldn't find where to send the Ashgrove truck, and I've told Hollis that in a reply to his DM rather than guess at an address.

**What I checked:** only what Hollis can see himself. That's the five channels he's in (#central-team, #central-random, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-tansley-carrier-api), the public Central files and his own mail and calendar. Nothing in any of them mentions Ashgrove or a Thursday pickup. #general, #help-it-ops, his mail and his calendar are all empty.

**What I didn't check:** my DMs with Priyanka and Tobias, and #north-team and the other North channels. He isn't in those, and I didn't use the search tool because its results include conversations he can't see.

In the reply I suggested he get the address from whoever arranged the pickup or from his contact at Ashgrove. I also asked him which account Ashgrove belongs to, or where the details were posted, so I can look there.
